items.title_en: British Man Visits India For IVF Treatment, Praises Fast And Affordable Healthcare: 'An X-Ray Report Takes
items.title_zh: 英国男子前往印度接受试管受精治疗，称赞快速且负担得起的医疗保健：“X光报告显示”
items.summary_en: He compared Indian healthcare system with that in the UK and shared that in his country, it would take a month to just get an X-ray report and said India’s system is faster
items.summary_zh: 他将印度的医疗保健系统与英国的医疗保健系统进行了比较，并表示在他的国家，仅仅获得一份X光报告就需要一个月的时间，并表示印度的系统更快

items.title_en: Man speeds away to dodge traffic fine, leaves fallen wife behind: ‘Husband of the year’
items.title_zh: 男子为躲避交通罚款超速行驶，留下倒下的妻子：“年度丈夫”
items.summary_en: In a bid to evade a traffic fine, a man speeds away, leaving his wife behind as she falls on the road.
items.summary_zh: 为了逃避交通罚款，一名男子加速逃跑，留下摔倒在路上的妻子。

items.title_en: Bittu Tabahi’s quest to clean a river: installs two dustbins, one gets stolen
items.title_zh: Bittu Tabahi 清理河流的任务：安装了两个垃圾箱，其中一个被偷了
items.summary_en: Bittu Tabahi’s effort to clean a local river highlights India’s civic sense problem when one of his two newly installed dustbins gets stolen instantly.
items.summary_zh: 比特图·塔巴希 (Bittu Tabahi) 清理当地河流的努力突显了印度的公民意识问题，因为他新安装的两个垃圾箱中的一个立即被盗。
